title: Knowledge base
subtitle: Local document assets: import, explicitly authorize per project, then search and cite in tasks.
errorUnsupportedType: Unsupported file type (text formats only in this milestone).
errorEmptyContent: The file has no indexable text.
errorFileNotFound: The file does not exist or has moved.
errorNotAFile: The selected path is not a file.
searchPlaceholder: Search the knowledge base (CJK by character, Latin by word)
emptyTitle: No documents imported in this scope yet
emptyDesc: Use Import document to pick a local text file; importing copies a duplicate and never touches your original file.
noHitDesc: Try another keyword, or make sure the document is authorized for the current project.
noAuthorized: No document is authorized for the current project
noAuthorizedDesc: Switch to Unassigned or All local knowledge, authorize documents for this project, then search again.
deauthorized: Authorization for the current project removed.
deleteHint: Deleting removes the index, chunks and authorizations only; your original file is never deleted.
previewNote: The snapshot is re-validated before execution: any authorization or document version change invalidates it, so stale content can never pass as current authorization.
previewEmpty: Nothing to inject right now (search or authorize documents first).
indexNote: Retrieval uses a CJK/Latin bigram inverted index (FTS5 is not enabled in this SQLite build); scores only rank results and are not a confidence percentage.
loadFailed: Failed to read the knowledge base
